gates.requiredScope: Prove exactly the seven accepted repositories and no foreign mutation.
gates.rationale: Fleet scope is a mandatory boundary.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Target registry, path, or mutation scope changes.

gates.requiredScope: Validate exactly five ordered fields for every active row.
gates.rationale: The shared five-field projection is the core contract.
gates.nABoundary: None while active order views are in scope.

gates.requiredScope: Resolve every complete intake filename link from each generated view inside its repository.
gates.rationale: Broken or shortened intake links violate traceability.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Intake path or view location changes.

gates.requiredScope: Compare all direct incoming edges, direction, kind, and literal binding with canonical manifests.
gates.nABoundary: Zero-edge rows still require the exact root fallback.

gates.requiredScope: Validate unique evidence-bound feature links or the exact no-feature fallback for every Completed row.
gates.rationale: Feature links may not be guessed.
gates.nABoundary: A row may have NoEvidence, but the gate remains Applicable.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Lifecycle, proof, or feature directory changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove zero lifecycle, position, role, root, or dependency-edge business changes.
gates.rationale: Presentation work must not alter series meaning.

gates.requiredScope: Run check/write/check and prove a second unchanged render causes zero diff and zero writes.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Renderer, normalization, input, or platform changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove Home Bash and PowerShell semantic and byte-contract parity on macOS, Linux, and Windows fixtures.
gates.rationale: Both maintained implementations form one contract.
gates.nABoundary: A supported platform may remain Open, never N/A.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Shell, platform, fixture, or output format changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove ten Completed rows, exact feature mappings 037 through 046, and six exact dependency tuples.
gates.rationale: TuiVision is the binding exact fixture.

gates.requiredScope: Prove feature 046 remains visibly latest while canonical position 10 and order 1 through 10 remain unchanged.
gates.rationale: Latest completion and canonical order are separate facts.

gates.requiredScope: Prove exactly one inactive DeferredOptional backlog entry with no position, dependency endpoint, or feature link.
gates.rationale: The optional intake must not become an eleventh active member.

gates.requiredScope: Require seven independent rows with current tests, links, UTF-8, A11Y, statistics, documentation, security, and agent-parity decisions.
gates.rationale: One repository cannot mask another repository's missing proof.
gates.nABoundary: Sub-gates may be N/A only with rationale and trigger.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any repository evidence or local governance changes.

gates.requiredScope: Record causal branch, PR, review, PreMerge, merge, PostMerge, default synchronization, and distribution state for every repository.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Authority, head, PR, merge, or sync state changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove zero product API, runtime, public type, image, Compose, dependency, package, and lockfile changes.
gates.rationale: The accepted feature is documentation-renderer work only.
gates.nABoundary: Product builds may be N/A for docs-only diffs, but boundary proof is mandatory.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any product, runtime, image, package, or lock path enters the diff.
